sanskrit:
पिताहमस्य जगतो माता धाता पितामहः ।
वेद्यं पवित्रमोङ्कार ऋक्साम यजुरेव च ॥ ९-१७॥
iast:
pitāhamasya jagato mātā dhātā pitāmahaḥ
vedyaṃ pavitramoṅkāra ṛksāma yajureva ca 9-17
translation: I am the Father of this world, the Mother, the supporter and the grandsire; the (one) Thing to be known, the Purifier, (the syllable) OM, and also the RIK, the SAMA and the YAJUH also.
